headline_takeaways: OPEN-WEIGHT JUDGE WORKS: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct served locally on a 2nd free ICE GPU closed the whole loop (judge->filter->vector->Delta-tau, Delta-tau=+1.2) with NO API key -> judge cost ~$0. On ICE the full grid is ~$0 cash (free GPUs), bounded by wall-clock + 16-GPU-h/job cap.
Wrong machine class for a LAPTOP: the reproduction needs CUDA + >=240 GB scratch; solved by GT PACE ICE (A100s + PB-scale scratch).
Workload counts are VERIFIED EXACT (153,600 gens, 2400/(ckpt,trait), 320 loads).
At RQ1 scale the dominant DOLLAR cost is the LLM judge API (~$40), 2-8x the GPU compute (~$5-20 on discount providers).
Judge is cheap-per-call: max_tokens=1 logprobs scoring, so cost is ~100% input-token-driven.
The pipeline is load/init-bound (~320 fresh model loads); keeping the model resident across steps would roughly halve GPU time.
A real overnight RQ1 OLMo-3 run is feasible on ONE A100 in ~5-12 h for ~$50 all-in.
Cheapest path: rent A100 ($0.78-1.65/hr, NOT hyperscalers) on RunPod/Thunder/Lambda; supply an OpenAI key.
